supplemental_line_coverage.note: Separate source-line union of compatible IR and non-IR measurements on identical production source contents; not a replacement for canonical IR counters. Statement measurements are recorded separately from line measurements.
supplemental_line_coverage.semantics: Supplemental source-LINE hit union only. A line is included once and is covered if an identified actual run records a positive DA count at the same source path and line. For each participating non-IR record, the full DA item set and production source SHA-256 exactly match the current IR record. No counters are manufactured, no items are excluded, and canonical IR LCOV is unchanged.
supplemental_line_coverage.limitations: This combines observations from different compiler coverage modes. It is not the coverage of a single build or deployed bytecode. No statement, branch, or function union is claimed; those metrics remain the separate actual report values.

supplemental_statement_coverage.semantics: Supplemental source-STATEMENT hit union across compiler coverage modes. Every participant has identical complete Statement byte-range item sets and source SHA-256 in actual canonical IR and non-IR debug reports. Count each canonical statement once; a positive hit in either report covers the item. Raw canonical counters and LCOV remain unchanged.
supplemental_statement_coverage.limitations: This combines source-item observations from different compiler coverage modes. It is not the coverage of a single build or deployed bytecode and does not establish exhaustive inputs or live deployment behavior.
